plain.li: It was in my dream last night, and I've been thinking about it all day.
This is going to sound silly, but I had a dream.
It came to me in a dream. I know how that sounds.
I keep seeing it when I close my eyes.

warm.li: I woke up this morning knowing what would make me happy.

blunt.li: Dreamt about it. Here's what I want.

cheerful.li: I had the best dream, and I want it to come true!

gloomy.li: I saw it in a dream. Usually that's as close as I get.

plain.li: I had {DREAM}, and now it's happened. I don't know what to make of it.
The others look at me differently since it came true.

warm.li: It came true, just like the dream. Maybe someone is looking out for us.

blunt.li: Told them it would happen. It happened. Next time they'll listen.

cheerful.li: My dream came true! I keep telling people about it.

gloomy.li: Now that it's come true, I'm not sure I want to dream anymore.

cold.li: Coincidence, most likely. I'll record my dreams more carefully from now on.
